count down: The audience began to count down from ten just before the New Year arrived.
新年到来之前,观众们开始从十倒数。
space travel: Many children dream of space travel and hope to visit the moon one day.
许多孩子梦想着太空旅行,希望有一天能登上月球。
solar system: The Earth is only one of the eight planets in our solar system.
地球只是我们太阳系八大行星中的一颗。
stomach ache: He ate too much ice cream and got a stomach ache last night.
他昨晚吃了太多冰淇淋,结果胃疼了。
catch a cold: Put on your coat, or you will catch a cold in this cold weather.
穿上外套,不然你在这么冷的天气里会感冒的。
take sb.'s temperature: The nurse will take your temperature before the examination begins.
护士会在检查开始前给你量体温。
fast food: Eating too much fast food is bad for your health.
吃太多快餐食品对你的健康有害。
take part (in sth.): All the students were invited to take part in the sports meeting.
所有学生都受邀参加了运动会。
in excellent condition: After months of training, the young athlete was in excellent condition.
经过几个月的训练,这位年轻运动员身体状况非常好。
feel awful: I feel awful about forgetting my best friend's birthday party.
我忘了好朋友的生日聚会,感觉糟透了。
all over: The little boy was wet all over after walking home in the rain.
小男孩在雨中走回家后,全身都湿透了。
She couldn't help laughing when she saw the monkey's funny face.
看到猴子滑稽的脸,她忍不住大笑起来。
orange-and-white: My little sister has an orange-and-white cat with big blue eyes.
我妹妹养了一只橙白相间、长着蓝色大眼睛的猫。
The brave firefighter won the heart of everyone in the small town.
这位勇敢的消防员赢得了小镇上每个人的心。
black-and-white: My grandparents still enjoy watching old black-and-white films on television.
我的祖父母仍然喜欢在电视上看老黑白电影。
tidy up: Please tidy up your room before your friends come over this afternoon.
请在你朋友今天下午来之前把房间收拾整齐。
sailing: We went sailing on the lake and enjoyed the cool wind.
我们去湖上航行,享受着凉爽的风。
come out: Her first novel will come out next month.
她的第一部长篇小说将于下个月出版。
as a result: He practiced hard every day, and as a result, he passed the driving test.
他每天都刻苦练习,因此通过了驾照考试。
make a list: Make a list of the things you need before you go shopping.
去购物之前,把你需要的东西列个清单。
at the end of: There will be a big party at the end of the school year.
学年结束时会有一场盛大的聚会。
at the same time: You can't watch TV and do your homework at the same time.
你不能一边看电视一边做作业。
daily life: Mobile phones have become an important part of our daily life.
手机已成为我们日常生活中的重要组成部分。
stay in touch (with sb.): Even after graduation, the two friends promised to stay in touch.
即使毕业了,这两个朋友也答应保持联系。
fill out: Please fill out this form and hand it in before Friday.
请在周五之前填写好这张表格并交上来。
point out: The teacher pointed out several small mistakes in my composition.
老师指出了我作文中的几处小错误。
sights: During our trip to Beijing, we visited many famous sights.
在北京旅行期间,我们参观了许多著名名胜。
at the top of: You can see the whole city at the top of the hill.
在山顶上你可以看到整座城市。
wake sb. up: My mother wakes me up at six every morning.
我妈妈每天早上六点叫醒我。
helpline: If you have any trouble with the product, call our customer helpline.
如果你在使用产品时遇到任何问题,请拨打我们的服务热线。
join in: Everyone was playing a game, and soon she joined in too.
大家都在玩游戏,很快她也加入了。
day by day: With the teacher's help, his English is improving day by day.
在老师的帮助下,他的英语正在一天天进步。
show sb. around: The guide showed us around the old castle last weekend.
上周末导游带我们参观了那座古堡。
on air: The radio station will be on air again at seven tomorrow morning.
电台明天早上七点将恢复播出。
presenter: The presenter introduced each guest with a warm and friendly smile.
主持人用热情友好的微笑介绍每一位嘉宾。
man-made: The lake in the park is man-made, but it looks quite natural.
公园里的湖是人造的,但看起来非常自然。
millions of: Millions of people watched the football match on television last night.
昨晚数百万人通过电视观看了这场足球赛。
go through: He went through a difficult time after losing his job.
失业后他经历了一段艰难的时期。
fall away: The path becomes dangerous because the ground falls away suddenly near the edge.
这条小路很危险,因为靠近边缘处的地面突然向下倾斜。
on top of: She put her favorite book on top of the small wooden box.
她把她最喜欢的书放在那只小木箱上面。
